title: Keep a named value
summary: F#: Keep a named value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: let gives a name to a value. It cannot be changed unless declared mutable.
learningObjectives: Keep a named value with F#

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.
let binds pencils to 3. The parenthesised expression gives printfn the number 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use parentheses to group a calculation passed to printfn.
